text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting! Here you are! The Special Stamina Sanzoku Fried Chicken Set with five extra pieces and side of ginger pork!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find Narita Brian in the cafeteria with a meal resembling something out of a food challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah… I feel a bit off at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I've learned from experience that whenever I'm tired, meat's the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Once I eat meat, that usually fixes whatever's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this wild form of self-care really will make her feel better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I may want to rethink her race schedule…
